chunks: Rijal al-Kashshi: Ibrahim ibn al-Mukhtar ibn Muhammad ibn al-Abbas, from Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Fadhal, from his father, from Abi Ja'far (peace be upon him)
(regarding the book of Yunus): This is my religion and the religion of my forefathers, and it is the whole truth.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the book of Yunus in Shia hadith literature?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kashi’s *Ikhtiyar* highlights the high status of Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman’s *Musnad* as a primary repository of Imami tradition, with Imam al-Sadiq (AS) equating its contents to the 'religion' of the Ahl al-Bayt. By declaring it 'the whole truth,' the Imam underscores its comprehensive nature in preserving creedal and legal teachings, reinforcing its authority among early Shia scholars who relied on it for authentic narrations.

en.ammaar-muslim: 2. [2/283] Rijal al-Kashshi: Ibrahim b. al-Mukhtar b. Muhammad b. al-Abbas from Ali b. al-Hasan b. Fadhal from his father from Abi Ja’far عليه السلام
(who said about the book of Yunus): This is my religion and the religion of my forefathers and it is the whole truth.
